Definition: from G1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of G5087 (in the sense of enacting); lawless, i.e. (by implication) criminal:--wicked.
BiblicalUsage: Peter says God delivered righteous Lot, vexed with the filthy conversation of the wicked, and he warns believers to beware lest they be led away with the error of the wicked. The word means lawless, living as though no law binds.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Lot's vexation is the mark of a righteous soul in a lawless place, and the warning still stands for us.
